name: StrategyQA
description: StrategyQA is a question answering benchmark where the required reasoning strategy is implicit and must be inferred. Questions are yes/no questions that require multi-step implicit reasoning. Along with each question, annotated decompositions and evidence paragraphs are provided to support reasoning chain evaluation.
reputation: Popular benchmark for evaluating implicit multi-step reasoning; widely used in chain-of-thought and reasoning papers; included in BIG-bench Hard
notes: Introduced at TACL 2021. The 'strategy' in each question is implicit—the model must infer what intermediate steps to take. Each question has annotated decomposition steps and retrieved Wikipedia evidence. Part of BIG-Bench Hard suite. Commonly used to evaluate chain-of-thought prompting benefits.
